description: Return bounded client-reported event counts, rollback share, auto-revert thresholds, and analytics availability for a release. Counts are events, not unique devices, installations, or adoption.

appId.description: OtaKit app ID. Optional on a local connection whose project configures one; required otherwise.

window.description: Period the counts cover, ending now (default 24h)
